ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jul-20-2006 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, VJ: Ollie Marie-Victoire, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Carl Sauceda.
Petitioner: Jiezhen Zhao, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Jianhong Zhao, and with Cantonese Interpreter: Charles Zhang.
Co-Petitioner/Minor's Father: Deming Zhao, not present in court, but signed the Petition consenting to the name change for the Minor.
Petitioner and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Simon Hong Zhao.
Decree signed in open court.
